data.name: Hemp Carbon Standard
data.description: Hemp Carbon Standard (HCS) is a Calgary-based wholly-owned subsidiary of Hempalta Corp (TSXV:HEMP), which has pivoted its strategic focus to nature-based carbon credits through HCS. HCS develops ISO 14064-2 methodologies and operates an AI/satellite-based MRV platform to generate carbon removal credits from industrial hemp cultivation — including regenerative soil carbon, hemp biochar, and biomass burial — running an on-farm program with 13 Alberta farms plus partners in the US and internationally.
